QuestInfo.name: Talking Tree's Request 3
QuestInfo.0: The #bTalking Tree#k on the #bShining Forest Path in Ellinia#k has a request.
QuestInfo.1: Nothing seems to be going the Talking Tree's way. It thinks becoming a mushroom will somehow drive away its troubles...\r\n\r\n#i2213002##t2213002#  #b#c2213002# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: The Talking Tree asked to be left alone...

0.0: Hm. They're...not talking. Why? Why can't any of them talk? Why am I doomed to be the only intelligent tree?
0.1: Just...just forget it! No matter what I do, I can't grow taller or make the other trees shorter. I hate being a tree! I wish I was something else!

yes.0: I hear that Alchemists can make all sorts of things. I hear they even make potions that can transform you into different kinds of creatures. I want to be a Green Mushroom! Bring me a #bGreen Mushroom Transform Potion#k!

no.0: Sure, that's easy for you to say, you...Walky McLeggerson!

1.0: Is that the Green Mushroom Transform Potion? Give it, give it! I'll drink it and shed this tortured arboreal existence!

yes.0: I...I'd like to do this on my own. Thank you for everything. Now go away.

item.0: What, no #bGreen Mushroom Transform Potion#k? Get your Alchemist friend to help me out!
